addr: Rooftop, Galaxy Club, Brigade Gateway, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560055, India

rev.t: Nice place to host an evening event for around 200 people, ambience is good, well maintained. Food was very good too. …

It is good place for small gatherings, but little expensive, buffet is not good, they are providing small plates for food I don't know why, it can't sufficient place in that plates for two verities of food. And taste is also not good for what we are paying that money.

What an amazing venue to have a private event. We had a family wedding reception here. Open air place, with a closed space too. Located on 7th floor of WTC. It’s beautiful for a evening party. The event was well organised. Catering is also done by them. Food was excellent. Overall wonderful experience
